## Why visit

The most individual of Liverpool’s historic pubs: a former landlord’s extraordinary interior combines murals, stained glass, carved details and patented drinking tables. Explore the snugs as well as the crowded central bar; the Dickens and Hogarth themes make the rooms feel like a private world. This is a particularly good counterpoint to the more formal grandeur of the Philharmonic. It deserves the short extension south of the usual Hope Street route because its character cannot be replicated by substituting another attractive Victorian pub.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA three-star interior. Music sessions can change the mood; visit earlier for a closer look at the rooms.

**Getting there:** Egerton Street south of the main Hope Street cluster; plan as a deliberate walking extension.
